title: Audio Preset Definition
description: Schema for ALIS audio presets. Field names must match USTRUCT property names (case-insensitive) for FJsonObjectConverter auto-parsing. Every AUDIO_*.json file MUST include a $schema field pointing to this file (relative path).

id.description: Unique audio preset ID (used for FPrimaryAssetId).

source_offset.description: Relative location offset from actor for sound source position: (X=val Y=val Z=val)

source_rotation.description: Relative rotation for sound source (cone direction): (P=pitch Y=yaw R=roll)

Attenuation.description: Spatial attenuation settings. Field names match FAudioAttenuationConfig UPROPERTY names (PascalCase). Omit entire block to use sound asset's own attenuation.

FalloffDistance.description: Distance beyond inner radius where sound fades to silence in cm.

ConeAngle.description: Inner cone angle in degrees (full volume). Cone shape only.

ConeFalloffAngle.description: Outer cone angle in degrees (fades between inner and outer).

BinauralRadius.description: Binaural radius in cm. Binaural method only.

tracks.description: Available audio tracks for this preset

id.description: Track ID used in actions (e.g. audio.play:shot)
